g.title: fit
g.text: One plant fit, used in both directions
estimator TOML and the navigation defaults.
are the fitted plant: run forward
in the filter, inverted in the controller.

g.title: our
g.text: • commands re-read at t − delay_s, 2 ms arc substeps
heading innovation > pi/2 → position rows only

g.title: opp
g.text: correct at its own stamp, re-propagate

g.title: coast
g.text: renders every track forward to the control clock
our EKF coasts up to max_coast_s of unmeasured age,
then holds position while covariance keeps growing

g.title: target
g.text: picks the goal pose for the active mode

g.title: vref
g.text: latency lead + coast horizon, both from the fit

g.title: fb
g.text: a dead-reckoned speed is our own command

g.title: wref
g.text: w_ref = kp·e + kd·de/dt, clamped to max_yaw_rate

g.title: ulin
g.text: u_ff = (v_ref + tau·dv/dt) / k_fwd, tau by sign of dv/dt
steer-brake divided out: u / max(floor, 1 − c_sb·|u_ang_eff|)

g.title: tx
g.text: update() reads the channels back as CommandFeedback

g.title: tx->ring
g.text: (the same command the plant model integrates)
